items.title: What's on This Page
items.why:
The button groups outside setup, from review 39. Each one gets a page with how it looks now and the setup styles you picked there: a dropdown line, or a list with ticks.

1. Effort when logging an activity
2. Stomach symptoms
3. Sore areas (Gymnastics check-in)
4. Skill event
5. Skill stage
6. Plates your gym has
7. Food search filters
8. Restaurant menu sort

The new styles are mock-ups made from the app's own setup pieces, on a test copy, in the Goku look in dark mode. Nothing in the app is changed yet.

My recommendation is Keep for all eight. Each is one tap now and fits in two rows or fewer, except sore areas (four rows, under the body map). A dropdown adds a tap every time, and a list makes the screen longer. You may still prefer one look across the app; any mix works.

items.title: Effort, 1 to 10
items.why: Shown on every activity you log.

options.label: Big number with − and +
options.desc: Like the bloating line. Starts at 6, as now. Each tap moves it by one, so 10 is 4 taps away.

items.title: Stomach Symptoms
items.why: In Nutrition → How You Feel Today → Stomach. Several can be picked.

options.label: Dropdown
options.desc: Opens the same list, with Done.

items.title: Sore Areas
items.why: The body map above it stays either way; tapping the map picks the same areas. Several can be picked.

items.title: Skill Event
items.why: When adding or editing a gymnastics skill. One is picked; the stage names change with it.

items.title: Skill Stage
items.why: Same screen, below the skill name.

items.title: Plates Your Gym Has
items.why: On a barbell exercise's edit screen. Set once, rarely changed.

options.label: List with ticks
options.desc: Like the equipment list in setup.

items.title: Food Search Filters
items.why:
Shown when a search finds more than 8 foods of different kinds: All, Basic foods, Restaurants, Brands, My foods. They scroll sideways, so the last one or two are past the edge, as in the picture.

The dropdown mock-up leaves out the counts (like 254); I'd keep them if you pick it.

items.title: Restaurant Menu Sort
items.why: Shown when the search names a chain. "Fits what's left" also shows when you have a calorie target.

items.title: Publish?
items.why: If you pick Keep for all eight, nothing changes and there's nothing to publish. Otherwise, after your picks I build them, run every check on both looks, then publish 2.31.0.
